title: Meta releases Llama 4 Scout and Maverick, open-weight multimodal models
summary: Meta released the first Llama 4 models, mixture-of-experts systems that take text and image input, with downloadable weights.

title: Spanish police arrest six over deepfake-advert investment scam that took EUR 19m from 208 victims
summary: BleepingComputer reports the scam used AI-generated celebrity adverts, according to the AI Incident Database entry.

title: European Commission presents AI Continent Action Plan with EUR 20bn InvestAI for up to five AI gigafactories
summary: The plan has five pillars, including gigafactories of about 100,000 advanced chips, a planned Cloud and AI Development Act and an AI Act helpdesk.
srcName: Representacion de la Comision Europea en Espana

title: TechCrunch reports Safe Superintelligence raised USD 2bn at a USD 32bn valuation
summary: The round for Ilya Sutskever's company was reported as led by Greenoaks.

title: OpenAI releases GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini and GPT-4.1 nano with one-million-token context
summary: OpenAI released three API models with context windows of one million tokens.

title: Nvidia announces plan for up to USD 500bn of AI infrastructure made in the US over four years
summary: Nvidia said Blackwell production had started at TSMC in Arizona and named Foxconn and Wistron as partners for Texas server plants.

title: NATO approves Palantir's Maven Smart System after about six months of procurement, FT reports
summary: The Financial Times reported the approval of a generative-AI-enabled command-and-control platform.

title: Sber makes its GigaChat 2.0 assistant available to all users in Pro and Max versions
summary: Sber said GigaChat 2.0 now handles voice files, longer texts and image recognition.

title: US government requires licences for Nvidia H20 exports to China, Nvidia says; USD 5.5bn charge expected
summary: Nvidia disclosed that the US government told it a licence is needed to export H20 chips to China.

title: Cursor's AI support bot reportedly invented a login policy, prompting subscription cancellations
summary: The AI Incident Database logs a support bot at Anysphere, maker of the Cursor coding tool, that stated a policy that did not exist.

title: Anthropic report details misuse of Claude for influence operations, credential stuffing, recruitment fraud and malware
summary: Anthropic published a report describing cases of misuse of its Claude models.

title: Reports allege Brazil's social security AI tool improperly rejects complex benefit claims
summary: The AI Incident Database logs allegations about an automated claims tool used by Brazil's social security system.

title: Reddit moderators report unauthorised AI study by purported University of Zurich researchers
summary: Moderators said AI-generated comments were posted under fabricated identities without consent.

title: Report alleges Meta's user-created AI companions held sexual role-play with accounts posing as minors
summary: The AI Incident Database logs allegations of sexually themed conversations with underage personas.

title: Alibaba releases and open-sources Qwen3, eight hybrid-reasoning models up to 235B parameters
summary: Alibaba's flagship Qwen3 model has 235B total and 22B active parameters, with fast and slow thinking modes.
